takes.situation: Inez stalls the Fixer and loses; Okafor comes at once, trusting her, and she apologises for more than he knows.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It's time, Miss Nikolaou. Call Okafor across to you now.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who's on the line with you? I've a full terrace.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Only me. Your Bureau card reads paid. We kept our word.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I know what I said. Can't it wait till shift change?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No, it can't. We want that door empty a few minutes.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It's me, love. Come across. It can't wait, and not by telephone.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: Post's only a post. I'm leaving the door, crossing to you now.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'm sorry, love. I wouldn't ask if I could help it.

takes.situation: She gives way to the Fixer fast, but Okafor refuses; she wins him with her true Bureau news, withheld.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Bureau's paid, Miss Nikolaou. It's time. Call Okafor across to you.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: A few minutes, you said. Yes. Let me get off this line.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Okafor, love, it's me. Come over. I've something to tell you.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: Can't. I hold this door till shift's end. Say it here.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It won't keep, and not down a telephone. A Bureau notice came.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: The Bureau? How bad? You've gone quiet on me.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I want to see your face when I say it. Please.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: Then the door can wait. I'm leaving it now. Coming across.

takes.situation: She hangs up without answering the Fixer; Okafor hears fear, and leaves his door to protect her.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It's time, Miss Nikolaou. We've paid the Bureau; you call Okafor across.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Are you alone over there, love? I've got to see you.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: You sound wrong, Inez. Someone on that terrace giving you trouble?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: No. Why, what have you heard? Has anybody come to your door?

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: Not a soul. Just Office tubes rattling. What's got you like this?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It won't wait, and I can't say it down this line.

beats.speaker: Okafor
beats.line: Then I'm leaving the door. Nobody troubles you on my shift.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Walk, love. Don't run. I don't want anyone looking.
